about: How the studio mixes a piece in one pass, where a browser cannot pause its offline audio between the bots' decisions (public/studio/compose.js `pausesOffline`: Firefox, to date). The piece is then composed on the score engine -- the bots as in an audio render, their notes and no audio -- each part is played on its model as in any browser, and the parts are put through the band's own mixer at the places and in the hall its spec gives, in one offline render with nothing deciding as it goes. `tailSeconds`: how long past the last part's end the hall is let ring before the mix is cut. `floorDb`: the level under which the end of the mix is silence and is cut away, dBFS. `leastSeconds`: the least the mix is kept after its last part ends, s.
